name: quorum
description: Triage director for multi-bot PR reviews: clusters bot findings, sorts them into agreed and solo lanes by reviewer quorum, and keeps one ledger comment with a merge gate for humans and agents. Includes an optional cloud exploration runner.

scripts.build:skill: git archive --format=zip --prefix=quorum/ -o quorum.skill HEAD -- SKILL.md scripts references && echo quorum.skill rebuilt from HEAD
scripts.test: npm run build && node --test dist/test/*.test.js && python3 -m unittest discover -s scripts/tests -v
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run build && npm run build:skill && npm test

overridesNote: zod is a peer dependency of @cursor/sdk (declared ^3.25.0 || ^4.0.0); npm auto-installs the 3.x line, which has an open advisory (GHSA-mrhx-c7xc-m3w5, fixed in 4.6.6). The pin selects the patched 4.x the SDK already supports. Remove when the SDK raises its peer floor to >=4.6.6 or drops zod. Rationale: docs/dependencies.md (tracked in #5).
